_readme: The countdown reads data/exams.json and never shows a date that has not
been officially announced. Question of the Week reads
data/question-of-the-week.json. The timer asks the student for the time
printed on their paper; no paper length is stated on these pages.
Every link on these pages points to an existing page. When a section is
renamed, update the links here too.

blocks.heading: Make a weekly study timetable
intro: Type your subjects, mark the ones that need extra time, and choose how many sessions you can manage. The timetable gives weaker subjects more sessions and avoids the same subject twice in a day. Your choices stay on this device.

blocks.heading: Sit a past paper under time
intro: Set the time printed on the paper, start the timer, and work without stopping. You will be told at halfway and with ten minutes left, and the clock turns red for the last ten minutes.
